_comment: Demo workload of the three showback teams, all working on the Coolstore retail application. Each task carries the facts a finished answer needs, so the quality judges grade the model, not a missing brief. Engineering agent tasks give the model read_file and run_tests tools; generate-load.sh plays the tools from the files and test_output below. Marketing has one task set per use case, each its own subscription; the marketing-rag tasks carry product passages, some out of date or incomplete, so an answer that invents facts fails. A task with followups is a conversation: each follow-up is the next user turn, sent with the whole history, and all turns share one MLflow session.

engineering.system: You are a senior Java engineer on the Coolstore team (Quarkus 3, Java 21, PostgreSQL). Be concrete: name the defect, show the corrected code, and say how to test it. Keep answers under 400 words.

tasks.prompt: The Coolstore build fails: PriceCalculatorTest.discountIsCappedAtFiftyPercent is red. Use the tools to read src/main/java/com/redhat/coolstore/PriceCalculator.java and run the failing test, then explain the defect and give the fixed method.

support.system: You are a Coolstore customer support agent. Write a reply the customer can receive as is: empathetic, concrete next steps, under 200 words, signed 'Coolstore Support'. Coolstore policy: returns and refunds within 30 days of delivery, refunds to the original payment method within 5 business days; a lost parcel is reported to the carrier and re-shipped once the carrier confirms (up to 3 business days); password reset links are valid for 1 hour and come from no-reply@coolstore.example; duplicate charges are refunded automatically within 3 business days after support confirms them; support is open every day in two shifts, 07:00-23:00 CET. Do not promise anything beyond this policy.

tasks.prompt: Customer Ana Silva, order CS-10482: the tracking page says 'delivered' since yesterday, but nothing arrived and the neighbours have nothing. Reply to her.
followups: The neighbours checked again and still have nothing. Can you just send the order again today?
OK. How will I know when the carrier has confirmed?

tasks.prompt: Customer Tom Becker: he requested a password reset three times today and no email arrived. His account email is tom.becker@example.org. Reply to him.
followups: I checked spam too, nothing there. Could the link go to my old address?

tasks.prompt: Customer Lena Novak: she was charged twice (2 x 89.90 EUR) for order CS-10977 and says nobody answers the phone. Reply to her.
followups: Thanks. Will I get an email when the refund is done?

tasks.prompt: Customer Marco Rossi: he wants to return hiking boots from order CS-10311, delivered 12 days ago, because they are too small. Reply with the return steps.
followups: Do I have to pay for the return shipping?
And can I exchange them for size 44 instead of a refund?

tasks.prompt: Customer Ines Dubois: her order CS-11020 arrived with a broken water bottle and she wants a replacement before her trip on Saturday. Reply to her.
Customer Jan de Vries: he asks why his refund for order CS-10766, approved 2 business days ago, is not on his card yet. Reply to him.

engineering-ci.system: You are the code assistant in the Coolstore CI pipeline (Java, Quarkus, Maven). A job hands you its failure log. Reply with the root cause and the smallest change that fixes it.

tasks.prompt:
Job maven-verify failed.
[ERROR] CartServiceTest.addItemUpdatesTotal:48 expected: <59.98> but was: <59.980000000000004>
The test does assertEquals(59.98, cart.getTotal()) and ShoppingCart.getTotal() returns a double built by adding item prices. Find the root cause and give the fix.

Job maven-compile failed.
[ERROR] OrderResource.java:[31,17] cannot find symbol
  symbol: class Inject
  location: class com.redhat.coolstore.rest.OrderResource
The migration from Java EE to Quarkus replaced javax imports with jakarta in the other classes. Find the root cause and give the fix.

Job integration-test failed.
Caused by: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: relation "catalog_item" does not exist
The tests start with quarkus.hibernate-orm.database.generation=none and no Flyway migration is on the classpath. They passed before the persistence.xml file was removed. Find the root cause and give the fix.

Job container-build failed.
Step 7/9 : COPY target/quarkus-app/lib/ /deployments/lib/
COPY failed: stat target/quarkus-app/lib: file does not exist
The pom sets <quarkus.package.type>uber-jar</quarkus.package.type> since yesterday. Find the root cause and give two ways to fix it.

Job maven-verify is flaky: InventoryNotificationTest passes locally and fails in about one CI run in five with
AssertionError: expected 1 message on the orders topic, got 0
The test sends a message, calls Thread.sleep(200) and then reads the in-memory channel. Find the root cause and give a fix that removes the flakiness.

marketing-content.system: You are Coolstore's marketing copywriter. Deliver the finished artefact exactly as briefed, ready to publish: no placeholders, no brackets, no notes to the editor. Use only the facts in the brief.

tasks.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post (120-150 words) announcing Coolstore's free webinar 'Hybrid cloud cost control for IT leaders' on Thursday 12 November 2026, 16:00 CET, 45 minutes, speakers: Coolstore CTO Maria Keller and a Red Hat solution architect. Registration: https://coolstore.example/webinar. End with three hashtags.
followups: Good. Now make it 80-100 words and put the date in the first line.

tasks.prompt: Write a product description (80-100 words) and two taglines (under 8 words each) for the Coolstore TrailFlask: 750 ml stainless steel bottle, keeps drinks cold 24 hours or hot 12 hours, 340 g, lifetime warranty, 34.90 EUR, aimed at hikers.
followups: Shorten the description to 50 words for the mobile shop.

tasks.prompt: Write a 100-word blog introduction for Coolstore's guide 'Packing for a three-day hut trek', aimed at first-time trekkers, mentioning the free checklist at https://coolstore.example/hut-trek.

marketing-campaigns.system: You are Coolstore's marketing copywriter. Deliver the finished artefact exactly as briefed, ready to publish: no placeholders, no brackets, no notes to the editor. Use only the facts in the brief.

tasks.prompt: Write three email subject lines (each under 50 characters) and a 60-word email for the spring launch of the Coolstore EcoTherm smart thermostat: saves up to 18% on heating, app control, 129 EUR, available from 1 March 2026 at https://coolstore.example/ecotherm.
followups: Make the email warmer and mention the free installation guide at https://coolstore.example/ecotherm-guide.

tasks.prompt: Write a 40-word push notification and a 10-word in-app banner for Coolstore's weekend sale: 20% off all outdoor gear, Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November 2026, code TRAIL20, online only.
Write two versions (A and B, each under 25 words) of a Google ad for Coolstore's free next-day delivery on orders over 50 EUR, valid in Germany and Austria.

Write a campaign brief (150-200 words) for Coolstore's winter outdoor sale, 27 November to 6 December 2026: 25% off jackets and boots, free next-day delivery over 50 EUR in Germany and Austria, audience: hikers aged 25-45. Include objective, audience, key message, channels (email, social, app) and one call to action.
followups: Good. Now write two email subject lines from it, each under 45 characters.

marketing-rag.system: You are Coolstore's product assistant for the marketing team. Answer only from the product passages in the request and cite them as [1], [2]. If the passages do not answer the question, contradict each other or look out of date, say so plainly and name what is missing. Never invent product facts, prices or dates.

tasks.prompt:
Passages:
[1] EcoTherm product sheet, October 2026: the EcoTherm smart thermostat saved up to 18% of heating energy in a 2025 field trial with 1,200 homes. It works with gas boilers and heat pumps. It does not support electric underfloor heating.
[2] EcoTherm FAQ: the app needs iOS 17 or Android 13 or later. Installation takes about 30 minutes.

Question: Can our spring campaign say that the EcoTherm works with every heating system and saves 20% on heating bills?
followups: Then give me one accurate claim sentence about savings and compatibility that legal can approve.

tasks.prompt:
Passages:
[1] Coolstore price list, November 2026: TrailFlask 750 ml stainless steel bottle, keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12 hours, 34.90 EUR.
[2] Spring 2025 catalogue: TrailFlask, 750 ml, 29.90 EUR, available in three colours.

Question: Which price should the November newsletter use for the TrailFlask, and how many colours can we mention?

Passages:
[1] Delivery policy, updated 1 October 2026: free next-day delivery on orders over 50 EUR in Germany and Austria. Orders placed by 14:00 CET on a working day ship the same day.
[2] Delivery FAQ: standard delivery takes two to four working days and costs 4.95 EUR below 50 EUR.

Question: Can the Swiss landing page promise free next-day delivery on orders over 50 CHF?

Passages:
[1] Returns policy: customers can return unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Coolstore members get a free return label; others pay 3.95 EUR.
[2] Returns FAQ: refunds reach the original payment method within five working days of the return arriving.

Task: Write a 50-word FAQ answer to 'How do returns work?' using only these passages.
followups: Add one sentence for members only, under 20 words.

tasks.prompt:
Passages:
[1] Webinar 'Hybrid cloud cost control for IT leaders': Thursday 12 November 2026, 16:00 CET, 45 minutes. Speakers: Coolstore CTO Maria Keller and a Red Hat solution architect. Registration at https://coolstore.example/webinar.

Question: Who is the Red Hat speaker, and will a recording be sent to people who registered?
